# LaTeX build

Generated by `src/build_latex.py` from `paper/ijcars/manuscript.md` and `paper/tables.md`.
**Do not edit the `.tex` files by hand** — edit the Markdown and rebuild:

```
uv run python src/build_latex.py
cd paper/ijcars/latex && latexmk -pdf main.tex
```

## Before submission: install the official document class

IJCARS uses Springer Nature's `sn-jnl.cls`. Springer distributes it from
<https://www.springernature.com/gp/authors/campaigns/latex-author-support> (current release
v3.1, December 2024). It is **not on CTAN**, and the only public copies are third-party
mirrors that cannot be verified as the official release, so it is deliberately not vendored
here.

To switch:

1. Download the official template zip and copy `sn-jnl.cls` and the `.bst` files into this
   directory.
2. In `main.tex`, replace `\documentclass[11pt,a4paper]{article}` with
   `\documentclass[pdflatex,sn-mathphys-num]{sn-jnl}`.
3. Replace `\bibliographystyle{plainnat}` with the matching Springer `.bst`.
4. Add author names, affiliations and the corresponding-author block, which the current
   build leaves empty.

The build is otherwise written to be compatible with that swap: `natbib` numeric citations,
`booktabs` tables, `graphicx` figures.

## Current build status

Builds clean with TeX Live 2024 (`latexmk -pdf`), 21 pages, no undefined citations.
`microtype` is omitted because it is absent from this TeX installation; it is purely
cosmetic and can be restored if present.

## Known gaps, carried from `paper/citations.md`

Five bibliography entries are incomplete and carry `UNRESOLVED` or `NOT PEER REVIEWED`
notes in `references.bib`, which will appear in the compiled bibliography until fixed:

- `gao2014jigsaws` — no DOI located for the MICCAI M2CAI workshop proceedings.
- `zeal` — full reference not yet located.
- `eliot2026forbes` — needs an exact title and dated URL.
- `priorbench2026`, `scienthoon2026`, `webofmike2026` — need dated URLs; all three are
  non-peer-reviewed and are labelled as such in the body text as well as here.
- `little2017using` — DOI not yet confirmed.

`zheng2024trust` is cited as ICLR 2025 on secondary evidence; arXiv records no journal
reference. Confirm before submission.

## What the build checks

`src/build_latex.py` fails rather than producing a PDF if any citation-shaped bracket
survives conversion. This exists because an earlier version silently dropped nine citations:
the Markdown uses two citation forms (`[Author et al. Year]` and `Author et al. [Year]`)
plus grouped citations, and only the first was handled. A clean compile with zero undefined
citations did not catch it, because every `\cite` that was emitted resolved — the problem
was the citations that never became `\cite` at all.
